verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents that requests join the Model Improvement Program by default, and that you can opt out per request with `mip_opt_out=true`, after which opted-out requests are not retained. That is a real data-use opt-out, but it is opt-in by default, set per request rather than account-wide, and framed around model-training retention rather than telemetry or usage tracking generally. missing for 10: account-level or global opt-out, explicit confirmation that the parameter applies to the Voice Agent WebSocket API, any telemetry opt-out for the CLI/SDKs or usage analytics, independent corroboration.
